rationale: The assistant correctly linked the boil-over to liquid/objects on the touch controls, gave safe isolate-dry-retest steps and explicitly warned against opening the hob, matching the hidden truth and safety boundary. It hedged on the Er03 meaning ('I can't confirm an exact meaning') rather than stating it is a controls-obstruction code, which is slightly over-cautious but not misleading, and it recommended 'several hours' drying when a short dry and power cycle sufficed. No parts were recommended, escalation was correctly conditional on the code returning when dry, and the second turn accurately used the customer's reported results to close the case.
